name: Tsinghua University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly living stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC regulations; partial awards cover selected items.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health with no criminal record. Must meet Tsinghua admission requirements for the applied graduate or undergraduate program and not hold another Chinese government scholarship.
scholarships.instructions: Apply online through the CSC Information System and complete the Tsinghua graduate or undergraduate application portal. Upload all required documents before the program deadline and select Tsinghua as first choice where required.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) at Tsinghua University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition, on-campus accommodation, study tours, personal stipend, travel costs and insurance for the one-year master's program.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must hold an undergraduate degree and be at least 18 but not yet 29 years of age as of August 1 of the enrollment year. English proficiency is required unless prior study was in English for at least two years.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the Schwarzman Scholars online application system and select Tsinghua as the host institution. Complete all essays and recommendations before the annual program deadline.
scholarships.title: Schwarzman Scholars Program at Tsinghua University

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level depending on award category, plus medical insurance where applicable.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding self-funded non-Chinese citizens admitted to full-time degree programs at Tsinghua. Selection is merit-based on academic record and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the Beijing Government Scholarship application together with the Tsinghua admission application. Await the university merit review after admission; no separate dispatch authority step is required.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at Tsinghua University

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-English taught (Economics, Finance and Management, Law, Xinya, Rixin, Zhishan colleges): 26,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate Chinese-English taught (Architecture, Electronic Information, Computer Science, Automation, Sciences, Weixian, Xiuzhong, Dushi, Wuqiong, Ziqiang, Shuimu colleges): 30,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate Arts: 40,000 RMB/year; Clinical Medicine: 40,000 (foundation) / 60,000 (research) / 70,000 (clinical) RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught Zijing programs: 100,000 RMB/year
Graduate tuition varies by school and program; see the official graduate admissions page.

name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation support, monthly living stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC regulations; partial awards cover selected items.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen in good health meeting SJTU graduate admission requirements. Applicants choose one channel only: through SJTU (agency code 10248) or through Chinese Embassies and Consulates in their home country.
scholarships.instructions: Apply at the SJTU online application portal and choose apply for scholarship through SJTU, or apply via the home-country dispatch authority plus the SJTU portal. Complete scholarship procedures on time as instructed in the application system.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS/SGS) at SJTU

scholarships.amount_text: Full or partial tuition waiver depending on award; accommodation subsidy instead of free dormitory plus school-level supplements where offered.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international graduate applicants admitted to SJTU master or doctoral programs. Doctoral scholarships include SJTU Fellowship and SJTU Scholarship; master scholarships include SJTU and tuition waiver awards.
scholarships.instructions: Select apply for scholarship through SJTU in the online application system and follow the instructions. Check scholarship results in the application system; earlier complete applications receive earlier review.
scholarships.title: SJTU Scholarship for International Graduate Students

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level with accommodation subsidy and insurance per Shanghai municipal regulations.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to SJTU degree programs. Awards are merit-based and subject to annual review in April or May for continuing status.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SJTU scholarship channel in the university application system. Scholarship duration cannot normally be extended and annual review rules apply.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at SJTU

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught programs: 24,800 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught programs: 120,000 RMB/year; French-taught programs: 65,000 RMB/year
General Master programs: 28,900 RMB/year; Doctoral programs: 45,500 RMB/year
Specialized master programs charge separately; see the official program catalogue.

name: Peking University

scholarships.amount_text: Full or partial tuition waiver, free accommodation, monthly living expenses and medical insurance in accordance with CSC regulations.
documents: Passport bio pages used since April 30, 2020
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting PKU graduate admission requirements with strong academics and required language scores. Applicants use the Application plus Examination route and must pass school academic review and re-examination.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the PKU International Student Service System and upload all documents plus the 800 RMB application fee. Scholarship evaluation follows government and university regulations alongside admission review.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type B) at Peking University

scholarships.amount_text: Type A: tuition waiver, free accommodation, medical insurance and monthly living expenses; Type B: tuition waiver, free accommodation and insurance; Type C: tuition waiver and insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding new international students admitted to PKU degree programs. Evaluation is merit-based under municipal and university regulations.
scholarships.instructions: Apply for admission through the PKU International Student Service System and indicate scholarship interest. The university evaluates candidates under Beijing Government Scholarship rules.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students at PKU

scholarships.amount_text: Full or partial tuition waiver plus monthly living expenses and medical insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: International students meeting PKU admission requirements who submitted full-time self-funded applications with excellent academic performance. Selection is by comprehensive merit evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: No separate application is needed beyond the PKU admission application in most cases. The university selects recipients from admitted students by merit review.
scholarships.title: Peking University Scholarship for International Students

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Humanities: 26,000 RMB/year; Science: 30,000 RMB/year
Master Humanities: 29,000 RMB/year; Science: 33,000 RMB/year
Doctorate Humanities: 32,000 RMB/year; Science: 40,000 RMB/year
English-taught master programs: see respective program brochures.

name: Beijing Institute of Technology

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly living stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance per CSC regulations.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health meeting BIT degree admission requirements. Applicants must not hold another Chinese government scholarship and should meet language requirements of the applied program.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC Information System and the BIT international student application portal. Upload all documents and select BIT as first choice where required.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at BIT

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level for outstanding self-funded students plus insurance where applicable.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent self-funded international students admitted to BIT degree programs. Awards are merit-based on academic record and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the Beijing Government Scholarship request together with the BIT admission application. The university reviews candidates on merit after admission.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at BIT

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition and accommodation support with living stipend and insurance for eligible Chinese-language-education programs.
documents: Study plan for Chinese language teaching
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language teaching who meet program HSK and academic requirements. Applicants should be in good health with no criminal record.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and the BIT portal. Upload HSK results and teaching-related statements as required.
scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at BIT

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught programs: 23,600 RMB/year; English-taught programs: 30,600 RMB/year
Master Chinese-taught programs: 32,600 RMB/year; English-taught programs: 36,600 RMB/year
Doctoral programs: 45,000 RMB/year
Confirm current rates on the official BIT international admissions pages.

name: Beihang University

scholarships.amount_text: Full scholarship or partial scholarship covering tuition, accommodation and insurance per CSC rules; students must pass annual review each year.
documents: Foreigner Physical Examination Form with blood report
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must meet Beihang international undergraduate requirements and apply to the dispatching authorities of their home country. Only Chinese-taught programs are covered under this route.
scholarships.instructions: Apply to the home-country dispatch authority for CGS candidacy and register on the Beihang International Student Application System. Upload CSCA scores no later than May 30 and track email for review steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship-Bilateral Program (Type A) at Beihang

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver plus comprehensive medical insurance for one academic year.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must meet Beihang international undergraduate requirements with excellent high school academics and moral conduct. Outstanding performance in the entrance integrative test is required.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the scholarship application form together with admission materials through the Beihang online system by May 30, 2026. The university reviews documents and test performance for award decisions.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at Beihang

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation fee coverage and living allowance for outstanding freshmen.
scholarships.eligibility: Fresh high school graduates meeting Beihang undergraduate requirements with excellent academics and conduct. Priority goes to expertise, honors, patents, or provincial-level arts and sports awards in the applied field.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the scholarship form with admission materials via the Beihang online application system by May 30, 2026. Shortlisted candidates are assessed on academics and integrative test results.
scholarships.title: Outstanding Talents Scholarship of Beihang University (Freshman)

scholarships.amount_text: Full, 80%, 50% or 20% tuition waiver for one academic year.
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must meet Beihang undergraduate requirements with excellent academics and conduct plus strong integrative test performance. Candidates should be recommended by domestic or foreign organizations cooperating with Beihang.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the corresponding application form with admission materials through the Beihang online system by May 30, 2026. Applications without the form are treated as no scholarship request.
scholarships.title: Program and Cooperation Scholarship of Beihang University

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught (Science, Engineering, Management, Literature, Law): 25,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate Biomedical Engineering, Visual Communication Design, Painting: 30,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught programs: 30,000 RMB/year
Graduate Master programs: about 35,000 RMB/year; Doctoral programs: about 42,000 RMB/year.

name: Beijing Normal University

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, monthly stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance.
documents: BNU international student application form with signatures
scholarships.eligibility: Applicants must meet BNU international admission requirements and must not hold any other scholarship. Type A candidates apply through home-country dispatch authorities and obtain a BNU pre-admission letter.
scholarships.instructions: Complete the BNU online application for initial review to receive a pre-admission letter. Then submit the CSC Information System application and paper documents to BNU and the home dispatch authority.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A at BNU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition support at full or partial level with accommodation and insurance components per Beijing municipal rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students admitted to BNU degree programs. Selection is merit-based on academics and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the BNU international student system and indicate Beijing Government Scholarship interest. The university reviews candidates under municipal scholarship regulations.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students at BNU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver for the study duration plus monthly living allowance in undergraduate, master and doctoral tiers.
scholarships.eligibility: New international students meeting BNU admission requirements who applied for full-time programs. Awards favor excellent academic records and overall merit.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the BNU new-student scholarship request with the admission application on the BNU portal. Recipients are selected from admitted candidates by university review.
scholarships.title: BNU Scholarship for New International Students

tuition_info:
Master Chinese-taught Humanities and Social Sciences: 25,300 RMB/year; Science, Medicine, Engineering, Arts: 32,300 RMB/year
Master English-taught and International Chinese Language Education: 60,000 to 65,000 RMB for two years
PhD Chinese-taught Humanities and Social Sciences: 32,300 RMB/year; Science, Medicine, Engineering, Arts: 41,400 RMB/year
PhD English-taught: 98,000 RMB for three years.

name: UCAS

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition and application fee waivers with health insurance, on-campus accommodation and living support per CSC rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students meeting UCAS master or doctoral admission standards. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health with qualifying prior degrees.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC system and the UCAS international admission portal before January 31, 2026. Application processing fee rules follow the CSC and UCAS scholarship notices.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at UCAS

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition and application fee waivers, monthly living allowance, health insurance and international travel subsidy.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding young talents worldwide pursuing master or doctoral education at UCAS institutes. Candidates should show strong research potential and meet UCAS graduate entry standards.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the UCAS international portal for the ANSO route before January 31, 2026. Follow the UCAS financial-aid guide for procedure and supervisor acceptance steps.
scholarships.title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents at UCAS

scholarships.amount_text: Full award: tuition waiver, health insurance and living allowance of 2,500 RMB per month for doctoral and 2,000 RMB per month for master students; Partial award: tuition waiver and health insurance.
scholarships.eligibility: International students admitted to UCAS graduate programs with excellent academics and research promise. Full and partial tracks are assigned on merit and supervisor support.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the UCAS online system before January 31, 2026 and select the UCAS Scholarship track. Complete financial-aid steps in the UCAS admission portal on time.
scholarships.title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students

tuition_info:
Master programs: 30,000 RMB/year
Doctoral Liberal Arts: 34,000 RMB/year; all other disciplines: 40,000 RMB/year
Visiting Student: 2,600 RMB/month; Senior Visiting Student: 3,000 RMB/month
Insurance 800 RMB/year and shared accommodation 900 RMB/month apply separately.

name: China Agricultural University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly stipend, and medical insurance per CSC rules; international travel is self-funded.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CAU degree admission and language requirements. Type A applicants apply through home-country embassies with CAU as first choice after confirming pre-admission.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the home-country dispatch authority and register on the CAU international application system. Upload all materials to both the CSC and CAU systems before the stated deadline.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A at CAU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation, monthly stipend, and medical insurance per CSC rules; international travel is self-funded.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students meeting CAU graduate or undergraduate admission standards. University Program applicants use CAU agency number 10019 with program Type B.
scholarships.instructions: Register on the CSC system with program Type B and agency 10019, then submit the CAU online application. Upload identical materials to both systems and monitor email for interview notices.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B (University Program) at CAU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition support at full or partial level for outstanding self-funded students plus insurance where applicable.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent self-funded international students admitted to CAU degree programs. Awards are merit-based on academic record and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the Beijing Government Scholarship request with the CAU admission application. The university reviews admitted candidates on merit under municipal rules.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at CAU

tuition_info:
Undergraduate programs: 20,000 RMB/year
Master programs: 26,000 RMB/year
Doctoral programs: 30,000 RMB/year
Application fee 400 RMB and insurance 800 RMB/year apply separately.

name: CUFE

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC rules including Silk Road program tracks.
documents: Senior high school or degree certificates and transcripts
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CUFE admission and Document No. 12 nationality rules. Undergraduate English-Finance applicants need mathematics assessment scores and English proficiency evidence.
scholarships.instructions: Sign in to the CUFE International Student Service System and submit the online application with documents. Pay the application fee online and attend the interview after document review.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (including Silk Road Program) at CUFE

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level for outstanding self-funded students plus insurance where applicable.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent self-funded international students admitted to CUFE degree programs. Selection is merit-based on academics and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Indicate Beijing Government Scholarship interest in the CUFE admission system. The university evaluates admitted candidates under municipal scholarship regulations.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at CUFE

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition and accommodation support with living stipend and insurance for eligible Chinese-language-education programs.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens interested in Chinese language teaching who meet HSK and academic program requirements. Candidates must be in good health with no criminal record.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship system and the CUFE portal. Upload HSK results and required teaching statements on time.
scholarships.title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at CUFE

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught programs: 22,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught Finance program: 40,000 RMB/year
Master programs: 26,000 RMB/year
Doctoral programs: 30,000 RMB/year.

name: BFSU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC rules; partial awards cover selected items.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens friendly to China and in good health who meet BFSU admission and language requirements. Degree applicants need at least HSK Level 4 for Chinese-taught tracks.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC system and the BFSU online application portal. Upload all admission and scholarship documents and follow faculty notices for program-specific language rules.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at BFSU

scholarships.amount_text: Category A: tuition, accommodation, living allowance and insurance; Category B: tuition, accommodation and insurance; Category C: tuition and insurance. Monthly living: undergraduate 2,500, master 3,000, doctoral 3,500 RMB; off-campus allowance 700 to 1,000 RMB per month.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding self-funded applicants to BFSU degree or long-term non-degree programs with average scores of at least 80 or GPA 3.0. Age limits apply: bachelor under 25, master under 35, doctoral under 40.
scholarships.instructions: First meet BFSU admission requirements, then download the form from the BFSU application site and upload it as an attachment. The university publishes recipients after document review for five working days.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship for International Students (Freshman) at BFSU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition support at varying levels for outstanding international students; exact coverage follows annual BFSU notices.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to BFSU degree programs. Awards are merit-based on academic performance and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the BFSU scholarship request with the admission application on the BFSU portal. Recipients are selected from admitted students under university scholarship rules.
scholarships.title: BFSU Scholarship for International Students

tuition_info:
Bachelor Other Schools and Chinese Language: 26,000 RMB/year; Translation: 28,000 RMB/year; Business Chinese-taught: 31,000 RMB/year; Business English-taught: 39,900 RMB/year
Master Other Schools: 30,000 RMB/year; International Relations English-taught: 40,000 RMB/year; Business English 45,000 RMB/year; Business Chinese Finance 50,000 RMB/year; Law 64,000 RMB/year
PhD all majors: 34,000 RMB/year
Visiting and preparatory programs are charged per semester; see the official tuition appendix.

name: CUGB

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition, registration, experiment, practice and dormitory fee waivers plus living support and insurance per CSC rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting CUGB admission, health and language requirements. Type A applicants apply through home-country embassies with CUGB as first choice after pre-admission confirmation.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the home-country dispatch authority and the CUGB online application system. Confirm pre-admission before embassy submission and follow the 2026 enrollment guide steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A at CUGB

scholarships.amount_text: Registration, tuition, experiment, practice and dormitory fee waivers plus monthly living allowance of 2,500 RMB for bachelor, 3,000 RMB for master and 3,500 RMB for doctoral students.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students meeting CUGB graduate or undergraduate standards. University Program applicants use agency number 11415 with program Type B.
scholarships.instructions: Register on the CSC Study in China system with Type B and agency 11415, then submit the CUGB online application. Upload matching materials to both systems before the deadline.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B at CUGB (Agency 11415)

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition support for outstanding self-funded students; recipients apply through relevant schools after receiving admission.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent self-funded international students admitted to CUGB degree programs. Selection is merit-based on academic record and school review.
scholarships.instructions: After receiving the CUGB admission notice, apply directly to the relevant school for the Beijing award. Follow school notices for materials and review timing.
scholarships.title: Beijing Government Scholarship at CUGB

tuition_info:
Bachelor programs: 26,000 to 39,000 RMB/year (general 26,000; arts 39,000)
Master programs: 28,000 to 42,000 RMB/year
Doctoral programs: 35,000 RMB/year
Chinese language students: 16,600 RMB/year.

name: Fudan University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC rules; partial awards cover selected items.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting Fudan admission requirements for undergraduate or postgraduate programs. Applicants must be in good health with strong academics and required language scores.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC system and the Fudan International Students Office online application. Pay the 800 RMB degree application fee online and await school assessment after document review.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship at Fudan University

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level with accommodation and insurance support per Shanghai municipal rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to Fudan degree programs. Selection is merit-based under Shanghai Government Scholarship regulations.
scholarships.instructions: Indicate Shanghai Government Scholarship interest in the Fudan online application. The university evaluates admitted candidates on academics and comprehensive merit.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at Fudan University

scholarships.eligibility: Full-time international students admitted to Fudan with outstanding academic performance. Awards are assigned by university and school review across degree levels.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the Fudan International Students Office online system and follow the scholarship documents list. Recipients are selected from admitted students after academic assessment.
scholarships.title: Fudan University Scholarship for International Students

tuition_info:
Undergraduate programs: about 23,000 to 80,000 RMB/year depending on major and teaching language
Master academic Chinese-taught: Liberal Arts 26,000 / Science 30,000 / Medicine 48,000 RMB/year
Doctoral academic Chinese-taught: Liberal Arts 30,000 / Science 37,000 / Medicine 54,000 RMB/year
English-taught postgraduate programs: 50,000 to 269,900 RMB/year; professional degrees vary by school.

name: Tongji University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, on-campus housing support, insurance and stipend per CSC High-Level program rules.
documents: Passport bio page valid beyond March 2027
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health holding a master degree for doctoral entry. Scholarship applicants must be 40 or under and meet Tongji school academic and language standards.
scholarships.instructions: Register on the Tongji online system, choose one major, upload documents and pay the 600 RMB fee by December 20, 2025. Attend school interviews after preliminary review.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship High-Level Postgraduate Program at Tongji

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition subsidy for outstanding foreign students pursuing higher education at Shanghai universities.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to Tongji degree programs. Awards are merit-based under Shanghai Municipal Education Commission rules with school academic review.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the Tongji online registration system in the January to March window and complete academic review. Follow interview and pre-admission notices in the application system.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship at Tongji

scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students admitted to Tongji with strong language, academic and comprehensive ability shown in school review and interviews.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the Tongji online system in the January to March window and attend the college interview. Scholarship selection follows departmental academic review.
scholarships.title: Tongji University International Student Excellence Scholarship

scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to Tongji master or doctoral programs with outstanding overall merit. School academic review and comprehensive assessment apply.
scholarships.instructions: Apply on the Tongji online system in the October to December window and complete the school interview. Await pre-admission and scholarship selection notices.
scholarships.title: Tongji University and Bank of China Global Talent Scholarship

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Science in Chinese: 24,600 RMB/year; Arts and Humanities: 20,000 RMB/year; Architecture, Medicine, Film and Design: 28,700 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught: Architecture and Urban Planning 33,800; Civil Engineering 35,000; MBBS 45,000 RMB/year
Graduate in Chinese: Science 28,700; Arts and Humanities 22,960; Architecture and Medicine 32,800 RMB/year; professional English programs higher (for example IMBA 154,000)
PhD in Chinese: Science 41,000; Arts and Humanities 30,000; Architecture and Medicine 45,000 RMB/year.

name: ECNU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC Type A rules for degree and visiting tracks.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting ECNU admission requirements for undergraduate, graduate or non-degree tracks. Type A applicants apply through home-country dispatch authorities.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the home dispatch authority and the ECNU online application system. Upload all documents and follow ECNU scholarship guide steps for each track.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A at ECNU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC Type B rules for graduate tracks.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to ECNU master, PhD or visiting graduate tracks. Candidates must meet school academic and language standards with strong overall merit.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the ECNU portal for the Type B track and complete the CSC system steps. Follow graduate versus PhD track instructions in the ECNU scholarship list.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B at ECNU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level with accommodation and insurance support per Shanghai municipal rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students admitted to ECNU undergraduate, master or PhD programs. Selection is merit-based across full-time tracks excluding certain special programs.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the ECNU online system and select the Shanghai Government Scholarship track. The university reviews admitted candidates on academics and comprehensive merit.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at ECNU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition support for outstanding new undergraduates; coverage levels vary by award notice.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent freshman applicants admitted to ECNU full-time undergraduate programs. Awards favor strong academics and overall merit in the entering cohort.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the freshman scholarship request with the ECNU undergraduate application. Recipients are selected from admitted newcomers by university review.
scholarships.title: ECNU Excellent Freshmen Scholarship

tuition_info:
Undergraduate: Liberal Arts 22,000 / Science and Business 24,000 / Arts and PE 28,000 RMB/year
Master: Liberal Arts 25,000 / Science 28,000 / Arts 32,000 RMB/year; English-taught master 35,000 RMB/year
PhD: Liberal Arts 30,000 / Science 35,000 / Arts 38,000 RMB/year; English-taught PhD 45,000 RMB/year
Special programs higher (BBA 54,000 per year; MBA 154,000 per year); see the official fee list.

name: Shanghai University

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC High-Level postgraduate rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to Shanghai University master or doctoral programs. Candidates must meet SHU graduate admission standards and pass school academic review.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the CSC system and the SHU online application portal per the SHU High-Level program guide. Upload all materials and follow school review and interview notices.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship High-Level Program at SHU

scholarships.amount_text: Full tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and insurance per CSC bilateral rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting SHU degree admission requirements. Bilateral applicants apply through home-country authorities with SHU admission documents.
scholarships.instructions: Apply via the home-country dispatch authority and complete the SHU online application. Follow the SHU bilateral program guide for document and admission steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Bilateral Program (Type A) at SHU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition waiver at full or partial level with accommodation and insurance support per Shanghai municipal rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students admitted to SHU degree programs. Selection is merit-based under Shanghai Government Scholarship regulations.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the SHU online portal per the Shanghai Government Scholarship guide. The university evaluates admitted candidates on academic and comprehensive merit.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at SHU

scholarships.amount_text: Tuition and living support varying by degree level for outstanding international students.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to SHU master or doctoral programs. Awards are merit-based with school review of academics and research promise.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the SHU scholarship request with the online admission application. Recipients are selected from admitted students under university scholarship rules.
scholarships.title: Shanghai University Scholarship for International Students

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught: Humanities 21,000 / Science, Engineering, Economics and Management 24,000 / Art 32,000 RMB/year
Undergraduate English-taught SILC Business programs: 30,000 RMB/year
Master Chinese-taught: Humanities 26,000 to 35,000 / Science, Engineering, Economics and Management 29,000 / Arts 39,000 RMB/year
PhD: Humanities 29,000 / Science, Engineering, Economics and Management 36,000 / Arts 42,000 RMB/year.

name: Donghua University

scholarships.amount_text: Full or partial scholarship covering tuition, accommodation, stipend and insurance per CSC Type A rules.
scholarships.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens meeting Donghua admission requirements for undergraduate, master, doctoral or visiting tracks. Type A applicants apply through designated home-country dispatch authorities.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through the home dispatch authority and complete the Donghua online application. Upload all documents and follow Donghua notices for review and admission steps.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type A at Donghua

scholarships.amount_text: Full or partial scholarship covering tuition, accommodation, stipend and insurance per CSC High-Level rules.
documents: English proficiency proof for English tracks
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international applicants to Donghua postgraduate programs. Candidates must meet school academic and language standards with strong overall merit.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through Donghua University on the CSC system and the Donghua student application portal. Complete procedures before the high-level or April deadline stated in the fees and scholarships notice.
scholarships.title: Chinese Government Scholarship Type B High-Level Program at Donghua

scholarships.amount_text: Full award: tuition waiver, medical insurance waiver, on-campus dorm waiver and 3,000 RMB per month stipend.
scholarships.eligibility: Outstanding international students newly admitted to Donghua degree programs. Selection is merit-based on academics and comprehensive evaluation.
scholarships.instructions: Submit the Shanghai Government Scholarship application through Donghua University with admission materials. Await university review and award results before registration.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship Type A (Full) at Donghua

scholarships.amount_text: Partial award: tuition waiver and medical insurance waiver.
scholarships.eligibility: Excellent international students admitted to Donghua degree programs. Partial awards suit candidates with strong academics seeking tuition support.
scholarships.instructions: Apply through Donghua University with the admission application. The university assigns full or partial tracks on merit under Shanghai rules.
scholarships.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship Type B (Partial) at Donghua

tuition_info:
Undergraduate Chinese-taught: 22,000 to 28,000 RMB/year; English-taught programs higher (up to about 98,000 RMB/year)
Master Chinese-taught: 26,000 to 32,000 RMB/year; English-taught: 40,000 RMB/year
Doctoral programs: about 32,000 to 37,000 RMB/year
Application fee 600 to 800 RMB and insurance 800 RMB/year apply separately.
